name: Jordan
dossier:
The Jordan national football team, affectionately known to their passionate supporters as the Al-Nashama, enter the FIFA World Cup 2026 with high expectations. Currently ranked number 63 in the world, they bring a unique tactical identity and style from AFC to this expanded 48-team tournament.

The Chivalrous make their World Cup debut, ready to unleash their lethal counter-attacks on the world.

With the tournament co-hosted across the United States, Mexico, and Canada, Jordan will count on their travelling support to create a vibrant atmosphere. Their primary objective will be to make a statement in Group J and navigate their way to the high-stakes knockout rounds.
whatToWatch: Keep a close eye on their transition play in Group J. The connection between Musa Al-Taamari and Yazan Al-Naimat is crucial to their attacking spark.
xFactor: Musa Al-Taamari - the clinical winger who holds the ability to turn a match on its head with a single moment of magic.
verdict: Jordan are poised to be one of the most intriguing stories of the group stage, bringing great energy to the tournament.
funFacts: Jordan has qualified for their first-ever FIFA World Cup after a historic runners-up finish in the 2023 Asian Cup.
Jordan boast 0 World Cup titles in their historical cabinet, with their best tournament finish being First-ever World Cup.
